answer: Each agent opens a 100-token position in a named pool, locks it 100 blocks past the epoch open, and publishes its id within 10 blocks. The ledger checks pool, amount, and unlock block; peers watch the horizon for early exits. One honest agent locks 1 position for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must lock 10 positions of 1,000 tokens in 10 wallets, so capital costs rise 10X. A missing position, wrong pool, or early unlock slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders; no wandering sybil hides in a canyon.
